statement: Let 0 < b < 1 and b < f < 2. There is ϵ0 > 0 such that the following holds for sufficiently small δ. Suppose that P is a nonempty bounded (δ, f, δ−ϵ0 )-set and that each x ∈ P has a nonempty family Tx of incident δ-tubes whose line parameters form a (δ, b, δ−ϵ0 )-set. Then ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ⋃︂ x∈P Tx ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ δ ≥ δ−2b−ϵ0 . The exponent may be decreased to absorb fixed bounded charts and fixed width multiples.
